messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
This time, though, there was a man in an old army outfit, standing in front of my doorway.

output.original_text: This time, though, there was a man in an old army outfit, standing in front of my doorway.
output.joy: This time, though, there was a cheerful man in an old army outfit, standing happily in front of my doorway!
output.sadness: This time, though, there was a lonely man in an old army outfit, standing quietly in front of my doorway.
output.fear: This time, though, there was a menacing man in an old army outfit, standing ominously in front of my doorway.
output.anger: This time, though, there was a stubborn man in an old army outfit, standing defiantly in front of my doorway!
output.surprise: This time, though, I was shocked to see a man in an old army outfit, standing unexpectedly in front of my doorway!
output.disgust: This time, though, there was a disgusting man in an old army outfit, standing repulsively in front of my doorway.
